title: Synthetic training comments
outcome: 150 generated comments, plus a surface-realism variant, added to training folds only: out-of-fold macro-F1 0.8032 -> 0.8053 / 0.8063, inside noise. A TF-IDF model tells generated from real comments at AUC 0.94, so the generated comments are easy to tell apart from real ones. Not used.
note: Rerun for this record on CPU: AUC 0.942, out-of-fold 0.8032 -> 0.8053, matching the recorded numbers.
